heating_season_setpoint.name: Heating season setpoint
heating_season_setpoint.description: Outdoor-air temperature below which the unit treats the season as winter: it closes the bypass damper and runs heat recovery to warm the incoming air. Lowering it (e.g. to 5 °C for the night) keeps the bypass engaged so the unit can purge heat on a cool summer night. Must be reverted before the heating season — a low value left in place through winter causes under-recovery and excessive post-heating.

supply_air_defrost_temp.name: Supply air defrost temperature
supply_air_defrost_temp.description: Supply-air temperature at which the unit activates frost protection (defrost). A winter freeze-protection threshold — not a cooling control: lowering it does not engage the bypass (verified).

start_nocturnal_cooling.name: Start nocturnal cooling
start_nocturnal_cooling.description: Lowers the heating-season setpoint so the unit keeps the bypass open on a cool summer night, sets the Away profile supply-air target to 8 °C, and switches the unit to the Away profile (whose fan speed you have pre-tuned as the cooling intensity). Snapshots the current profile so the matching stop service can restore it. Verifies every write by raw register readback.

stop_nocturnal_cooling.name: Stop nocturnal cooling
stop_nocturnal_cooling.description: Reverts the heating-season setpoint to 15 °C, the Away profile supply-air target to 20 °C, and restores the profile snapshotted by start_nocturnal_cooling. Idempotent: a no-op if no cooling was started.
